game.title: Detective Interrogation
game.description: A compact branching interrogation scenario for local VeoQuest demos.

scenario.title: Detective Interrogation
scenario.description: A detective chooses how to question a suspect before evidence disappears.

settings.styleGuidance: Noir lighting, clear facial reactions, readable choices.

nodes.title: The Interview Room
nodes.description: The suspect watches the clock while the detective enters.
nodes.prompt: Noir interview room scene where a detective enters and the suspect watches the clock anxiously.

nodes.title: Apply Pressure
nodes.description: The detective confronts the suspect with a contradiction.
nodes.prompt: Continue the noir interrogation as the detective applies pressure with a contradiction in the suspect story.

nodes.title: Offer Empathy
nodes.description: The detective lowers the temperature and listens.
nodes.prompt: Continue the noir interrogation as the detective offers empathy and the suspect begins to trust them.

nodes.title: Confession
nodes.description: The suspect admits the truth before the evidence disappears.
nodes.prompt: Resolve the interrogation with a confession and a strong final noir image.

nodes.title: Hidden Proof
nodes.description: The suspect reveals where the missing evidence is hidden.
nodes.prompt: Resolve the interrogation with the suspect revealing hidden proof and the detective leaving quickly.

choices.label: Ask about the evidence
choices.description: Follow the trust into a practical lead.
